releases.recording_review: Target notes date the EMI performances to 1966–1969; the selected DG catalogue 4631272 is documented by Presto with 1981–1984 Paris recordings. Same pianist and works do not establish the same recording.
limitations: The candidate is excluded, not evidence that Qobuz lacks the EMI recording.

limitations: A remastered programme superset, not the identical Seraphim LP edition.
Whole-work timings agree within 3%; Tempest first/second movement timings differ materially from LP annotations, so individual take/session identity remains qualified.
